# Royal Mint

ID: `royal_mint`

The unique public v3 institution commissioned by a company\. It accepts physically delivered Silver into a reserve and issues bounded currency to the supplier and treasury\. It is not a private factory or a Company Value asset\.

**Content scope: Expanding Economy v3 only.** Historical worlds retain their original catalog.

## Recipes

None defined.

## Inputs and outputs


Construction payments, eligibility and production intervals belong to the active scenario.
